steps.en: PLUS sends a reduction request to OCMS
steps.id: PLUS mengirim request pengurangan ke OCMS

steps.en: The request carries the notice and the reduced amounts
steps.id: Request membawa notice dan jumlah hasil pengurangan

steps.en: Mandatory fields and format are checked on receipt
steps.id: Field wajib dan format diperiksa saat request diterima

steps.en: The request goes on to validation against the notice
steps.id: Request diteruskan ke validasi terhadap notice
